name: agent-sandbox-egress-policy
description: Checks that Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate resources enforce an explicitly scoped egress policy, rather than relying on the Secure Default or leaving networking unmanaged.
remediation: Set spec.networkPolicyManagement to Managed and define spec.networkPolicy with scoped egress rules. Use egress: [] for default-deny, or specify explicit to selectors for each allowed destination.
